# Include local graphics in a liteformat

Embed one or more local graphic files as base64 data URIs and return raw
HTML that
[`litedown::fuse()`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/litedown/man/mark.html) can
include directly in a document. This keeps the rendered document
self-contained without copying image files beside the source or output.

## Usage

``` r
include_graphics(path, alt = "", class = NULL)
```

## Arguments

- path:

  A character vector of paths to local graphic files.

- alt:

  Alternative text. Supply one string for all graphics or one string per
  path.

- class:

  An optional CSS class string added to every image.

## Value

Raw HTML output for use in a litedown code chunk.

## Examples

``` r
signature <- system.file(
  "liteformats/skeletons/signature.png",
  package = "liteformats"
)
include_graphics(
  signature,
  alt = "Handwritten signature",
  class = "signature"
)
#> 
#> ``` {=html}
#> <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Handwritten signature" class="signature" />
#> ```
```
